description: Injectable service for showing toast notifications. Register as Scoped in DI. Use TmToastContainer in layout to render. Toasts with Duration > 0 auto-dismiss on a timer driven by the registered TimeProvider (falls back to TimeProvider.System when none is registered — no JS interop required, works under any Blazor render mode; tests can substitute a FakeTimeProvider). A duration of 0 (or negative) makes the toast sticky.
